Near 1.0 s the shark moves about 115.2 px/s. Using the boat's scale gives 115.2 × 10/382.
The shark spans about 124 px from nose to tail. Its length is 124 × 10/382.
The shark spans about 47 px vertically, including its fins. Its height is 47 × 10/382.
